messages:
Maya: Weekend dilemma  doughnuts + boardwalk stroll (Sat 10am) or 25-mile bike loop + brewery stop (Sat 9am)? :doughnut: :biking_man: :beers:
Omar: Doughnuts for me. also I promise to not eat the whole box this time. :sweat_smile:
Talia: Bike loop sounds fun but 9am is brutal. Could we shift to 9:30?
Erik: 9:30 ok if we still hit the brewery by noon. Ill bring a patch kit and snacks.
Maya: If doughnuts wins, Ill bring maple bacon ones. if bike wins, Ill bring electrolyte mix.
Omar: Maple bacon?!?! doughnuts it is. but low-key Ill pedal if we need more people for the loop.
Talia: Vote: Doughnuts + stroll. easier and I can bring my camera for silly boardwalk photos. :camera_with_flash:
Erik: Im torn but leaning bike. fine with doughnuts if it means later brewery meetup.
Maya: Quick poll: [DoughnutsBoardwalk, BikeLoop+Brewery] current votes: DoughnutsBoardwalk (3), BikeLoop+Brewery (1)
ops-bot: calendar: Created event "Boardwalk & Doughnuts" for Sat 10:00 AM in #events.
Maya: Looks like doughnuts win. Meet at Pier 3 at 10am. Ill DM anyone who wants to swap to bike.
Omar: Count me in. bringing napkins and extra cash for clams. :money_with_wings:
Talia: See you Saturday! also bringing a ridiculous sun hat for photos.
Erik: Ill swing by after my morning ride if I feel like it. enjoy yall :wave:
